issue.title: Email alerts toggle reverts to on after reopening Settings
issue.body:
## Summary
The 'Email alerts' toggle reverts back to on after being turned off and navigating away from Settings.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open Settings > Notifications.
2. Toggle 'Email alerts' off.
3. Go back.
4. Reopen Settings.

## Expected Behavior
The toggle should stay off.

## Actual Behavior
The toggle is on again.

## Environment
- App version: v2.4.1
- OS: Android 14
- Device: Pixel 8

## Additional Notes
- Occurs every time.
